title: Allow Woodpecker Docker publish step
description: Pin the Woodpecker Docker buildx plugin image so the server privileged-plugin allow-list can match it exactly, and document/use the matching infra setting.

title: Use Wavefunk CI images in Woodpecker
description: Switch Sendword Woodpecker release and website steps to the published Wavefunk ci-rust and ci-node images so CI no longer installs Rust build dependencies or Wrangler during each run. Update docs and validate workflow YAML statically.
close_reason: Woodpecker release and website workflows now use the published Wavefunk ci-rust and ci-node images, per-run apt/npm setup is removed, docs updated, and workflow YAML parsed successfully.

title: Fix Woodpecker website trigger matching
description: Adjust the website Woodpecker workflow so CI configuration pushes can produce a matching website pipeline instead of Woodpecker reporting pipeline definition not found.

title: Fix allowthem 0.0.6 cargo check failures
description: Cargo check fails after bumping allowthem-core and allowthem-server to 0.0.6. Reproduce with direnv exec . cargo check, adapt sendword to the changed allowthem API, then verify with cargo check/tests.
close_reason: Fixed allowthem 0.0.6 API drift and verified cargo check/tests

title: Disable Forgejo Actions workflows
description: Remove the remaining .github workflow files so Forgejo does not discover Actions-format pipelines; keep Woodpecker pipeline files in .woodpecker intact.
close_reason: obsolete: Forgejo Actions deletion was not the selected fix

title: Cache Woodpecker release build dependencies
description: Add persistent Woodpecker volume mounts to the release pipeline so Rust build artifacts, rustup toolchains, Cargo registry/git data, Wrangler/npm installs, and Docker Buildx cache are reused. Also refresh Cargo.lock in a CI-like registry dependency state because the v0.8.2 release build failed under --locked after the local allowthem patch config produced path-only lock entries.
close_reason: Added release cache volume wiring and fixed CI lockfile state

title: Make release Docker image reuse built artifact
description: Change the release Docker publish path so it packages the Linux binary produced by build-artifacts instead of rebuilding Rust inside Docker. Keep cache settings where useful, but avoid duplicate cargo builds in publish-docker.
close_reason: Release Docker image now targets runtime stage that copies the build-artifacts binary

title: Upload release artifacts to remote R2

close_reason: Fixed upload script to call wrangler r2 object put with --remote and fail when no artifacts are present.

close_reason: Updated README and website install content to match current release options.
